title.value: Build a freelancer invoicing system with Claude Code

introduction.value: A freelancer built a client file, PDF rendering script and email script that send invoices and track payment status, replacing about 90 minutes a week of admin.

method.value: Alejandro Arce had Claude Code build three modular pieces. A JSON file holds client data, line items and payment status. A script fills an HTML template and uses Puppeteer to export a PDF. A Nodemailer script emails it over SMTP, records the send date, and sends a reminder after two weeks if the invoice is unpaid. He runs it once per billing cycle.

outcome.value: The build took about four hours, plus two more refining it. He says it replaced roughly 90 minutes a week of admin. He still marks invoices as paid by hand, and it has no payment processing or multi-currency support.

notes.value: Send test invoices to yourself before going live, because SMTP misconfiguration can send the emails to spam.

source_text.body:
Build a freelancer invoicing system with Claude Code
A freelancer built a client file, PDF rendering script and email script that send invoices and track payment status, replacing about 90 minutes a week of admin.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
Alejandro Arce had Claude Code build three modular pieces. A JSON file holds client data, line items and payment status. A script fills an HTML template and uses Puppeteer to export a PDF. A Nodemailer script emails it over SMTP, records the send date, and sends a reminder after two weeks if the invoice is unpaid. He runs it once per billing cycle.
How it went
The build took about four hours, plus two more refining it. He says it replaced roughly 90 minutes a week of admin. He still marks invoices as paid by hand, and it has no payment processing or multi-currency support.
Worth knowing
Send test invoices to yourself before going live, because SMTP misconfiguration can send the emails to spam.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Help me build a simple invoicing system in this folder for my freelance work. Create a client file with [name, email, rate, payment terms], a script that renders a PDF invoice from it, and a script that emails it and tracks paid or unpaid status. It's finished when I can run one command to make a test invoice for [client]. Show me the email and wait for my approval before anything is actually sent.
Original source: https://alejandroarce.com/blog/claude-code-invoice-automation/
